notes.title: Update #7025 - Improvements for Stalcraft X
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is the first small update in this year.

We fixed a bug when the crosshair in Hooks mode became a texture from the Stalcraft game. This fix affects all OpenGL games, of course.
Also we found & fixed interesting bug which could drop some fps on some PCs in Stalcraft X.
Fixed bug on multi-monitor systems: wrong HudSight window position on start-up in the case of disappearing of previously active monitor.

A new regular update is coming soon with new features related to crosshairs construction.

notes.title: Update #7012 - Compatibility with EAC games and other improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have some great news for you!

In this update, the most exciting thing is that HudSight 2 in draw mode «Hooks» is once again compatible with games that use Easy Anti-Cheat. We have developed a special workaround that allows us to inject our DLL signed with an old digital certificate that is whitelisted by EAC.

The issue has now been resolved for games such as Rust, Fortnite, Apex Legends, Throne and Liberty, Hunt: Showdown 1896, The First Descendant, War Thunder, THE FINALS, ELDEN RING, Dead by Daylight, Squad, Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, Crossout, Black Desert, VRChat, and many others that use EAC. Read the details at the end of this news.

We would like to remind you that we updated our digital code certificate in February, which needs to be whitelisted by Easy Anti-Cheat for our program to work correctly with their games. Unfortunately, after their transition to EPIC, we lost all contact with their staff and cannot reach anyone from them :(

Is this dangerous? Not at all. HudSight operates like an old whitelisted version when interacting with EAC-based games, and it does not contain any bad or unsafe «hacks».

Other changes in this release:
 Fixed a bug where the selected crosshair was not marked as a favorite.
 Improved compatibility for authentication and activation in Steam.
Helpful information!

We have created a file named games.txt containing a list of 75 popular games that use EAC anti-cheat. If your crosshair does not work in «Hooks» mode when launching a game with EAC and the game is not in the list, you can add the process manually. To do this, navigate to the root folder of HudSight at Steam\steamapps\common\HudSight\hooks\oldsign\ and open the file games.txt. Add the required process to the end of the file and report new games to support so they can be included in future updates. Please note that the program update will overwrite the file.

notes.title: Release #6990 notes
notes.content:
Hi there!

Changes in this build:

Added a new crosshair draw mode - Simple mode. You can read more about this mode on our web site.
Selection of the crosshair draw mode is moved to a separate tab in the main software window, where you can choose one of 4 modes: Simple Overlay mode, Real Overlay mode, Game Bar and Hooks modes. Each mode has its own pros and we're sure that you'll find your ideal option.
Added multi-display support in Simple and Real modes. You need to choose the active display in their settings where your crosshair will be displayed. 
Added several software interface localizations: Bulgarian, Czech, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish.

notes.title: Hot fix #6952
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with software freezing and demo message for some users after the latest update #6950.

Some computers are experiencing issues with license verification in the Steam version, and this is not related to a specific build of the program. We are investigating what the problem is.

What to do if the update didn’t help?

If you see a trial version notification when starting HudSight, try restarting your PC or just Steam, and launch the program from the Steam library using the green button. A white activation window should appear in the upper left corner, and the program should start after it finishes.

If that didn’t help, perform a clean installation by deleting the program along with the settings from C:\ProgramData\HudSight 2 and restart your PC. Then install the latest version 6952.

Still not working? Don't rush to leave a negative review, contact our support for assistance in resolving the issue. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Bug-fixes and minor additions - 6950
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Changes in this build:

Fixed «EMPTY» message bug when no crosshairs are available
Fixed bug drawing crosshair in the editor on low zoom
Fixed bug with interface rendering during moving main window by mouse
Fixed bad crosshair image naming in Workshop
Increased the maximum resolution of the crosshair editor from 256 to 1024
Added 2-dots crosshair generator style
Added -overlay command line switch with parameters hooks, xbox, real to start hudsight in the specific overlay mode
Added Simplified Chinese localization in test mode. Need a fix? Write to support
Added several new pre-installed crosshairs
Added «Show pixel offset» feature in the crosshair editor
White list mode is now indicated in app window caption
Added tray menu with only «Close Hudsight 2» item
Changed UI color scheme a bit


Important information!

In this version 6950 digital code signature has been updated and EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat) has not yet added it to its whitelist, so all games which use this Easy Anti-Cheat will not display (temporarily) overlay if you select «Default (hooks)» as the method of drawing crosshairs in the «Common» tab.
So use our new «Real Overlay» or «Microsoft Xbox Game Bar» in such cases, or use the previous version 6910 on the beta channel «oldsign - old digital signature». To do this open the HudSight properties - «Betas» and select this branch from the drop-down list.

notes.title: HudSight Version 2 (major update) #6900
notes.content:
Hello, everybody!

We've just released a new major update for HudSight - version 2.
This version has new interface, it may seem a bit complicated but don't be afraid :)

What are the changes, in two words:

Custom profile for every crosshair (with one default profile for all other crosshairs)
Added support for Steam workshop (as another way for custom crosshairs)
Added image generator for fast creating of crosshairs
Better image editor usability (undo/redo is added)
Added support for «Xbox Game Bar» widget as alternative for «Hooks».
Read more here https://hudsight.com/support/xbox-gamebar-crosshair-overlay

Some of new features are not included in this release and they'll be enabled in the next updates.
Next updates will also have another alternative to «Hooks» and Game Bar widget. We know some gamers do not like xbox bar, so you will have similar feature but without «Xbox» letters :)

notes.title: Crosshair Lean and Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
We have a new build #5400 and here are the changes:

Added crosshair lean feature. Enable it in the crosshair settings and bind two hotkeys which you use in your game to lean and your custom crosshair will lean with your ingame character! But you will need to find the best angle for your crosshair (and set it)
Added achievements! :)

Added ability to bind Left mouse button key for some action :)
Minor fixes for black/white lists
Fixed bug with invisible crosshair if it was hidden (by your command through the hotkey) and then you have cleared this hotkey.
Fixed compatibility with Forza 4, Path of Exile ;)

notes.title: Improved custom crosshairs support and black list
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

Take a look to this new update #5330, we hope you will like it ;)

Extended support for crosshair visibility by a hotkey. Standard mode is "one press to show, one press to hide". Now you can turn on an alternative mode where the hotkey will work as "hold to show, release to hide or vice versa".
Interface of HudSight is changed to keep it simple but with new additional settings. Crosshairs list now can be edited - you can add or remove built-in or custom images.
A blacklist is now available in the program settings. In fact, the blacklist was existed before but it had some imperfections ;) Now it is better and opened for you.
We have added advanced hidden feature :) Click with right mouse button to a crosshair in the crosshairs list and you'll get ability to bind a "switch to" hotkey for this crosshair. Now if you press it while in-game, this crosshair will be selected as active.


Stay tuned, new features are coming soon ;)
